name: Unending Torment

angles.text: For the Forsaken, alchemical torment to bind reanimated remains to the Dark Lady's service is part of daily life in the Apothecarium.
The Royal Apothecary Society continues brewing sinister concoctions deep beneath Lordaeron's ruins and testing the limits of alchemical subjugation.
Gathering Blisterweed from the Apothecarium's herbalist trainers shows how ordinary botanical study overlaps with the Society's darker alchemical work.
The work takes you into the Rogues' Quarter to buy Essence of Agony, a potent reagent favored by poison crafters and assassins.

faq.answer: Master Apothecary Faranell offers it. He leads the Royal Apothecary Society and can be found in the Apothecarium within the Undercity.
faq.q: Who offers the quest Unending Torment?

faq.answer: Faranell needs three ingredients: a Toxic Skullcap from Tawny Grisette in the Trade Quarter, Blisterweed from near the herbalism trainers in the Apothecarium, and Essence of Agony from a poison vendor in the Rogues' Quarter.
faq.q: What reagents are needed for Faranell's concoction?

aliases: who is the lost sheep faranell mentions
faq.answer: Faranell is experimenting on an unwilling captive whose severed head has just been reattached. He mockingly calls him a 'lost sheep' and an 'honored guest,' and seeks to crush the defiant bravado he clings to after severe beatings.
faq.q: Who is Master Apothecary Faranell experimenting on?

faq.answer: Faranell's potion is meant to mentally break the subject and bind it to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner's will. She is the Dark Lady of the Forsaken.
faq.q: What is the goal of Faranell's potion?

faq.answer: Tawny Grisette is in the Undercity's Trade Quarter, where she supplies specialty goods including the Toxic Skullcap the apothecaries need.
faq.q: Where can players find Tawny Grisette?

faq.answer: Blisterweed grows near the Undercity's herbalism trainers, the Alliestars, in the Apothecarium. Faranell says they owe him a favor, so adventurers may take what is needed.

sections.body: Deep in the Undercity's Apothecarium, Master Apothecary Faranell conducts experiments to strengthen the Forsaken. He has reattached the severed head of a battered captive. Now he needs a special alchemical mixture to crush the creature's remaining resistance and bind its will to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
sections.title: Binding the Will

sections.body: Faranell sends his agent across the Undercity to gather potent ingredients for his brew. A Toxic Skullcap comes from Tawny Grisette in the Trade Quarter. Blisterweed is held by nearby herbalist trainers who owe him a debt, and a poison vendor in the Rogues' Quarter sells Essence of Agony.
sections.title: Apothecary Reagents

sections.body: With the ingredients in hand, Faranell is grimly satisfied with the masterpiece he is about to make. He looks forward to testing the concoction on their 'honored guest.' He trusts the agonizing draught to strip away the captive's remaining bravado and return the stray creature obediently to the Dark Lady's service.
sections.title: The Masterpiece

summary: In the Undercity, Master Apothecary Faranell prepares a brew to bind a captive to the Dark Lady's will. He needs lethal reagents from across the Forsaken capital to finish it.
